description: The weekly summary of the 35 main markets (currencies, crypto, metals, energy, agriculture, stock indices) from the latest Legacy report: net positions of speculators and commercials and their change. Available at every level. Both CFTC variants (Futures Only and Futures & Options Combined) with COT Premium and Data API keys; without an account and with a free account, each report's default variant.

variant.description: CFTC variant: futonly = Futures Only, combined = Futures & Options Combined. Default: the report's own (Legacy: futonly; Disaggregated, TFF: combined; Supplemental is published combined only).

name: get_weekly_summary
title: COT weekly summary
